text:
Pure iron is a soft metal.
When mixed with small amounts of tungsten it produces a hard alloy called tungsten steel.
Which statements are correct?
1
Pure iron is a transition element.
2
The particles in pure iron are arranged in ordered layers.
3
Tungsten steel is a compound.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry

content.html: Pure iron is a soft metal.
content.text: Pure iron is a soft metal.

content.html: When mixed with small amounts of tungsten it produces a hard alloy called tungsten steel.
